pages.text: Paintings have been in the game for a while. Thingamajigs adds a few more for fun. Most of them are either based off of a source of some kind, or are reference or gag.

The Thingamajigs Painting item allows placement of Thingamajigs paintings, and is somewhat compatible with other painting mods that change painting behavior (you may not get the special item back, instead the vanilla one in some cases).
